question:
Select the correct spelling of the underlined word in the following sentence.

You can eat anything you like __accept__ the rice pudding.
solution:
The correct answer is "**except**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The blank in the sentence implies that the subject was allowed to eat anything but the rice pudding.**
 
• **Thus, the usage of the word "accept" is incorrect.**
 
 
• **It should be replaced with the correct spelling i.e. "except."**
 
• 'Except' means to exclude or leave out.(के अलावा)
 
 
• ​Example: The shop is open everyday except on Sunday.
 
 
 
 
 
• ​​Thus, the correct sentence will be: 
 
 
• ​You can eat anything you like except__ the rice pudding.
 
 

​​Hence, **the correct answer is option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2 - accede: This word means to agree or give in to a demand or request.(मान लेना)
 
• Option 4 - assess: This word means to evaluate or judge the quality or value of something.(आकलन)
